# Changeling
A changeling is an intelligent alien creature capable of taking on a human appearance. Changelings are aliens in the form of headslugs, but before the round begins they either transform into someone while still off-station, or somehow kill someone and assume their identity through unknown means. A changeling's main weapons are its ability to synthesize dangerous chemicals internally, transform into other creatures it has absorbed, and blend in with people.
A changeling can become anyone it has absorbed and switch identities instantly; only the absorption process requires time and privacy. Unlike a traitor, a changeling's sole objective is to survive until the shuttle arrives and escape aboard it while wearing someone else's face.
Remember that changelings are not required to work together, and some may act alone or become lone wolves depending on their preferences. \n ## I transformed into myself. What should I do? \n
## Chemicals Chemicals fuel your abilities. Without them, you cannot use your powers. They regenerate slowly over time, and absorbing someone increases your maximum capacity.
## Biomass Your biomass is your health. You begin with 30 units of biomass. You consume 1 unit of biomass every minute, and absorbing someone restores it completely. When your biomass gets too low, the crew will begin to notice the effects of your decomposition, such as: - Vomiting blood - Severe trembling - Death. You cannot die through conventional means such as blunt trauma, but your biomass slowly drains away. If you fail to absorb someone before it runs out, it is game over.
## DNA Absorption Your greatest weapon is deception. Transform into other humanoid creatures to confuse the crew. To do so, take ANY person, living or dead (even bodies discarded after cloning), and absorb them using the "Absorb" or "DNA Extraction Sting" ability. You can store a maximum of 5 DNA strands at once and must transform to make room for more.
Absorbing DNA requires the victim to be incapacitated, in critical condition, or dead. Simply cuff them, put them into critical condition, or kill them if necessary before absorbing them.
- Absorbing someone takes a long time, so prepare a safe location or do it where as few people as possible can hear you. - Absorbing a victim fully restores your biomass, increases your maximum chemical capacity, and grants bonus evolution points for purchasing new abilities. - Absorbing another changeling also increases your maximum biomass capacity, allowing you to stay alive longer, and grants even more chemicals and evolution points. - [color=red]Absorbed victims cannot be cloned.[/color] They can, however, still be turned into cyborgs.
## You exclaim: "I'm the only one left!" Changelings can only absorb so much DNA at once! If a changeling has 5 stored DNA strands and attempts to acquire another, it must discard old DNA by transforming. Eventually, every changeling will be forced to become the double of someone else on the station, living or dead. A changeling can alter its appearance to look and sound exactly like a victim it has absorbed. This can pose an enormous security threat, especially if members of Command have been absorbed and the changeling can impersonate them. Changelings can also use the "Lesser Form" ability to turn into monkeys and get up to monkey business.
## Regeneration Also known as "Regenerative Stasis," changelings can "kill" themselves and appear dead. After an indefinite period, a changeling can rise again at will, completely healed of all wounds and diseases. Entering stasis drains all of a changeling's chemicals, while exiting costs 60. Chemicals continue to regenerate while the changeling is dead, meaning it can always enter stasis as long as its biomass is not critically low.
Changelings may also choose to be revived with a defibrillator, making them even harder to identify.
This makes them nearly invulnerable, as they can fully regenerate even after death if they have enough chemicals. Changelings thrown into space can also return to the station if given enough time. The best way to get rid of a changeling for good is to let it starve by sending it to the mines or placing it in solitary confinement.
## Working alone or as a team Like traitors, changelings act individually and are not required to help one another. They do not even need to reveal their identities to other changelings, as it is not uncommon for them to betray each other to eliminate the competition. Nevertheless, [color=red]a coordinated group of changelings is a genuine threat[/color].
# Identifying a changeling Changelings have a distinct blood type. Even when a changeling is impersonating a diona, vox, or moth, it still has the same blood type. Changeling blood also reacts violently when placed in a centrifuge. There is no other way to identify a changeling unless it begins behaving openly suspiciously.
